candidates.summary: the gnoweb seed-realm branch is the one path into plan.Realms that skips the Ignore guard
candidates.failure_scenario: A maintainer sets `ignore = true` on a seed realm (two examples packages carry that flag today). Every gnoweb PR then plans it: BuildPlan appends it because the seed loop tests only `pkgs[r] != nil`, while a direct change (plan.go:220) and an indirect one (plan.go:241) both drop an ignored package. Its directory goes to gnodev, which filters ignore=true extra-root packages before genesis deploy (contribs/gnodev/pkg/packages/loader.go:507, loader_test.go:475), so gnoweb 404s the page: the posted comment links a realm the preview does not contain, and when the ignored realm sorts first — gno.land/r/docs/security_patterns is Realms[0] of every gnoweb-only PR — waitReady (main.go:131, crawl.go:604 requires 200) polls it for the full 5-minute timeout and the render step fails with "gnoweb not ready after 5m0s".
candidates.verify_by: fixture repo with examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/home carrying `ignore = true`, BuildPlan(root, ["gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go"], 25): expect Realms without it, observe it planned
candidates.evidence: TestSeedRealmIgnoreIsSkipped: "ignore=true seed realm planned: Realms = [gno.land/r/gnoland/home], Dirs = [examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/home]" --- FAIL

candidates.summary: the subtest rewrites maxRealms 0 into defaultMaxRealms, so the flag's documented "0 for no cap" never reaches BuildPlan
candidates.failure_scenario: `-max-realms 0` is documented as no cap (main.go:73) and the guard that implements it is `maxRealms > 0` (plan.go:256). No test calls BuildPlan with 0: the table's `limit == 0` means "use the default", so flipping the guard to `maxRealms >= 0` leaves the suite green while `-max-realms 0` truncates to realms[:0], empties Realms, and turns a realm PR into "nothing to preview" with no error.
candidates.verify_by: in the head worktree change plan.go:256 to `maxRealms >= 0 &&` and run go test ./misc/gnopreview: expect red, observe green

candidates.summary: Empty() passes a plan with Gnoweb true and zero realms, which render() then indexes at Realms[0]
candidates.failure_scenario: Empty() is `!p.Gnoweb && len(p.Realms) == 0`, so a gnoweb-only plan whose seed realms are not in the tree (all four renamed or removed — boards2/v0 carries a version segment) is non-empty. The workflow's own skip test is the same predicate (pr-preview.yml:78), render()'s guard is Empty() (main.go:111), and main.go:131 then evaluates urlOf(plan.Realms[0]): the job dies on `index out of range [0] with length 0` with a Go stack instead of printing "nothing to preview". plan_test.go:111-121 pins that shape as the expected output of the only gnoweb case.
candidates.verify_by: fixture repo with no seed realm, BuildPlan(root, ["gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go"], 25): expect Empty() true or a realm, observe Empty() false with zero realms and urlOf(Realms[0]) panicking
candidates.evidence: TestSeedlessGnowebPlanIsEmpty: "Empty() = false with 0 realms; render() then panics: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0" --- FAIL

candidates.summary: Pkg.Draft is parsed and assigned and no caller ever reads it
candidates.failure_scenario: modFlags parses `draft = true` and LoadPkgs stores it on every package, but `grep -n 'Draft' misc/gnopreview/*.go` returns only the declaration (plan.go:58) and the assignment (plan.go:142): BuildPlan filters on Ignore alone. A reader takes the field for a guard that exists, and the removal touches plan.go:58, plan.go:142 and the `case "draft=true"` arm of modFlags.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'Draft' misc/gnopreview/*.go — two hits, both writes
candidates.evidence: plan.go:58 field, plan.go:142 assignment; no read anywhere in the package

candidates.summary: in "both" mode with a changed realm, Shots is always empty, so the gnoweb blurb promises a sample the comment never carries
candidates.failure_scenario: main.go:147 takes the pairs branch whenever len(plan.ChangedRealms) > 0 and only then falls back to Screenshot(), so a PR that touches gnoweb and one realm has plan.Shots nil. Comment still writes "This PR changes **gnoweb** and realm sources" and calls shotGrid(p.Shots, base), which returns "": the reviewer of a gnoweb change that also edits a realm gets realm before/after tiles and no rendered sample of gnoweb itself.
candidates.verify_by: read main.go:147-152 against comment.go:47-54: the only assignment to Plan.Shots sits in the else-if branch that len(ChangedRealms) > 0 excludes
